name: The Outlaws of Stirwood Forest

specialRules.name: Bows only
specialRules.text: Every warrior may have only one missile weapon at a time and must carry a type of bow (not crossbows) as part of his equipment, even if skills would allow other ballistic weapons. The Cleric may choose to carry a bow but is not compelled to.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: Bounty Hunter, Wolf-Priest of Ulric, Norse Shaman and Dark Elf Assassin are not available.

specialRules.name: Cleric slot
specialRules.text: The Cleric can only be taken instead of a Champion or a Petty Thief.

equipmentLists.name: Outlaws equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: All Outlaws fighters (Bandit Leader, Champions, Cleric, Petty Thieves, Marksmen, Outlaws)

items.name: Hunting arrows
items.note: Heroes and Marksmen only. Available to Heroes at initial recruitment without a Rarity roll.

items.name: Forest cloak
items.note: Heroes and Marksmen only. Rare 10, Outlaw Heroes only; no Rarity roll at initial recruitment. Wearer beside a tree, bush or hedge is -1 BS to hit by missile weapons; spellcasters must roll 7+ on a D12 to target him unless within Initiative range in inches.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any model within 6" may use her Leadership instead of their own.

fighters.name: Cleric

specialRules.name: Disciple of Sigmar
specialRules.text: Starts knowing one Prayer of Sigmar. May wear armour (prayers are not spells). May learn neither Sorcery nor Arcane Lore.

fighters.notes: Can only be taken instead of a Champion or a Petty Thief (counts against their limits).

conversionNotes: Forest cloak: 'rolling a 4+ on a D6' to target a camouflaged model -> 7+ on a D12 (4+ -> 7+).
Equipment list printed 'Staff/Clubb/Mace 3 gc' (sic); split into Staff, Club and Mace at 3 gc each.

Items marked * (Longbow, Light armour, Hunting arrows, Forest cloak) are available to Heroes and Marksmen only; Outlaws (plain henchmen) cannot buy them. Restriction recorded in item notes, not enforced by the file structure.
Marksmen are 0-7 and Outlaws unlimited, both Henchwomen/henchmen. The Cleric's slot is exclusive with a Champion or Petty Thief; max entered as 1 with the swap noted.
Printed double-handed weapon cost is 30 gc (not 15). Bandit Leader rule text says 'her Leadership'. Cleric's Prayers of Sigmar list is not included in the PDF; refers to Mordheim rulebook p.57.
The PDF title text and header disagree (Stirland/Stirwood); the file uses Stirwood.
